placeholder.en-US: Select the account this contact belongs to

helpText.zh-CN: 联系人必须归属于一个客户，客户关系决定后续商机和跟进范围。
helpText.en-US: Every contact belongs to an account, which anchors opportunity and activity relationships.

helpText.zh-CN: 填写客户组织中可识别的真实姓名。
helpText.en-US: Use the person's recognizable business name.

helpText.zh-CN: 职位用于判断决策角色和沟通重点。
helpText.en-US: The title helps sellers understand decision influence and conversation focus.

placeholder.zh-CN: 选择负责维护该联系人的销售人员
placeholder.en-US: Select the seller responsible for this contact

helpText.zh-CN: 新建时默认当前用户；负责人同时驱动“我的联系人”和“本部门联系人”视图。
helpText.en-US: Defaults to the current user and drives the My Contacts and Department Contacts views.

helpText.zh-CN: 邮箱是联系人更新导入的业务匹配键，请使用工作邮箱。
helpText.en-US: Email is the business match key for update imports; use a work address.

helpText.zh-CN: 填写座机及区号，便于团队统一识别。
helpText.en-US: Include the area or country code so the team can recognize the number.

helpText.zh-CN: 填写可用于日常沟通的手机号。
helpText.en-US: Use the mobile number suitable for day-to-day communication.

helpText.zh-CN: 设为主联系人后，同一客户的其他主联系人会自动降为普通联系人。
helpText.en-US: Setting this contact as primary demotes any other primary contact for the same account.

placeholder.zh-CN: 例如：关注交期，周二下午便于联系
placeholder.en-US: e.g. Focused on delivery dates; best reached Tuesday afternoons

helpText.zh-CN: 记录稳定的沟通偏好或业务背景，不在此填写敏感凭据。
helpText.en-US: Capture durable communication preferences or business context, never credentials.
